logline: 성냥팔이 소녀가 눈 내리는 섣달그믐 거리에서 성냥을 한 개비씩 켠다.
destination: 성냥불 속에 비치는 따뜻한 방 — 켤 때마다 보이는 자리
protagonist: 낡은 숄을 두르고 맨발로 선 열 살 남짓 소녀
anchor: a girl of about ten in a threadbare shawl, bare feet, a bundle of matches in her apron
palette: snow blue-white, window amber, deep night indigo, warm orange

match_girl.label: 성냥팔이 소녀
match_girl.desc: a girl of about ten, thin face, threadbare grey shawl over a patched dress, bare feet, apron of matches

street.label: 눈 내리는 거리
street.desc: a snowy street at night, tall shuttered houses, one lit window, drifting snow

warm_room.label: 성냥불 속의 방
warm_room.desc: a warm room glimpsed as if through glass, laid table and lit stove, everything golden

beats.beat: 소녀가 눈 쌓인 거리 모퉁이에 서 있다.
beats.visual: a thin girl in a shawl standing barefoot at a snowy street corner, shuttered houses above
a girl holding out matchboxes toward passing coats on a snowy street, nobody looking down
beats.motion: the coats stream steadily past her outstretched hand

beats.beat: 불 켜진 창 안으로 차려진 상이 보인다.
beats.visual: a lit window seen from a dark street, a laid table and moving figures inside
beats.motion: warm light spills steadily from the window onto the snow

beats.visual: a girl in a shawl huddled into a corner between two walls, snow piling at her bare feet
beats.motion: snow gathers steadily against her feet

beats.beat: 소녀가 앞치마에서 성냥 한 개비를 꺼낸다.
beats.visual: a girl drawing a single match from an apron of matchboxes, cupped hands shielding it
beats.motion: her cupped hands close steadily around the match

beats.visual: a small flame on a match cupped in a child's hands, her face lit from below
beats.motion: the flame wavers steadily against her palms

beats.visual: a warm iron stove glowing in golden light seen as if through frosted glass
beats.motion: the golden light swells steadily around the stove

beats.visual: a girl in a shawl on a dark snowy street, a spent match between her fingers
beats.motion: the last glow thins away from the match

beats.beat: 소녀가 두 번째 성냥을 그어 든다.
beats.visual: a girl striking a second match, her thin face turned toward the new flame
beats.motion: the second flame climbs steadily in her hand

beats.beat: 불빛 속에 상 위의 음식이 비친다.
beats.visual: a laid table of steaming dishes in golden light seen as if through frosted glass
beats.motion: steam rises steadily from the dishes

beats.beat: 소녀가 남은 성냥을 한꺼번에 그어 댄다.
beats.visual: a girl holding a whole handful of lit matches, her face and shawl bathed in orange
beats.motion: the massed flames climb steadily higher in her hands

beats.visual: a golden room growing brighter beyond the flame, a figure standing with arms open
beats.motion: the light widens steadily toward the figure

beats.beat: 소녀가 그 빛을 향해 손을 뻗는다.
beats.visual: a girl in a shawl reaching one thin hand toward a widening golden light
beats.motion: her hand reaches steadily toward the light

beats.beat: 눈 덮인 모퉁이에 성냥개비만 흩어져 있다.
beats.visual: spent matchsticks scattered on fresh snow at a cobbled street corner, dawn light
beats.motion: snow settles steadily over the matchsticks

withheld: 마지막 불빛 속에서 소녀가 만나는 사람과, 이튿날 아침의 일
